query: WITH ended AS (UPDATE agents a SET revoked_at = $2 FROM users u WHERE u.id = a.user_id AND a.sign_in_method <> 'oidc' AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND split_part(email_key(u.email), '@', 2) = ANY($1) RETURNING a.id), tokens AS (UPDATE agent_tokens t SET revoked_at = $2 FROM ended e WHERE t.agent_id = e.id AND t.revoked_at IS NULL) SELECT count(*) AS "ended!" FROM ended
